checks.name: Twitter Thread Non-Empty
checks.description: Each tweet in thread must be non-empty and non-blank.

checks.name: Whitespace Cleanliness
checks.description: Content must not contain untrimmed leading or trailing whitespace.

checks.name: Hashtag Normalization
checks.description: Hashtags must be correctly prefixed with '#' and free of internal punctuation.

checks.name: Factual Context Relevance
checks.description: Content must be factually aligned with source text and avoid unsubstantiated claims.
